== Response

Actions::
* Kind: containment; What: Mask the card number in the checkout log and purge the affected log index; Role: role:developer; Issues: PAY-1423; Done: yes
* Kind: recovery; What: Rotate the keys of the log store that held the card data; Role: role:service-owner; Issues: PAY-1431; Done: yes

Timeline::
* At: 2026-11-19T07:10:00Z; What: The monitoring finds card numbers in a search of the checkout log.
* At: 2026-11-19T07:40:00Z; What: The incident is confirmed and the security team takes over.
* At: 2026-11-20T16:00:00Z; What: The log index is purged and the masking filter is live.
